method: BASELINE. scope: Family assistance (TANF): s 349 A, B.1, D; s 131(6) and its fair hearing; s 131(10); s 350(2)(a); s 131-n(1); s 131-a(1), (2)(a-4), (b), (d), (e), (3)(a-4), (b), (c), (3-c), (3-d), (7), (8)(a)(i)-(iii), (v), (viii), (xiii), (b), (c). Shelter and fuel allowances and the June-adjusted disregard percentage are inputs. Out: safety net assistance, emergency assistance, work rules, stepparent deeming, lump sums, HIV rent cap, special items.
seat: the family assistance applicant (a parent, another caretaker relative, or a pregnant individual)
